name: AsiaJet
blurb: TAA Group's Kuala Lumpur-based Asian carrier, operating a unified fleet of 102 Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft.

about: AsiaJet traces its origins to QantasLink before its acquisition by TAA Group. Following the acquisition, the airline was rebranded as AsiaJet and established operations in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Today, AsiaJet operates as part of TAA Group alongside Trans Atlantic Airlines and EuroStar.
network: Kuala Lumpur International Airport is AsiaJet's primary hub. Its single-type fleet of 102 Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft supports the carrier's network.
